faq_heading: New construction in Boundary Beach: your questions answered

faq.q: What have houses in Boundary Beach sold for?
faq.a: 9 houses sold in Boundary Beach at a median of $1,741,900, with the middle half between $1,300,000 and $1,849,900.

faq.q: How long do homes take to sell in Boundary Beach?
faq.a: In Boundary Beach, townhomes were quickest at 4 days at a median, and houses slowest at 29 days.

faq.q: Which homes in Boundary Beach are the newest?
faq.a: Of the homes that resold in Boundary Beach, duplexes had the newest median build year, 2026.

items.t: In Boundary Beach, houses sold at a median of $1,741,900 across 9 sales, and the middle half closed between $1,300,000 and $1,849,900. The median house sat 29 days and sold for 98.1% of list.
Boundary Beach: 8 townhomes sold at a median of $1,199,900, with the middle half between $1,032,425 and $1,263,675. The median townhome took 4 days to sell and closed at 100.0% of list.

9 duplexes sold in Boundary Beach at a median of $1,299,900 (middle half $1,249,900 to $1,359,900). A typical duplex in Boundary Beach spent 14 days on the market and closed at 100.0% of the asking price.

blocks.text: Source: Paragon closed sales, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026; medians need 5 or more sales.
How Boundary Beach compares with the rest of Tsawwassen

items.t: Of 8 Tsawwassen sub-areas with 5 or more house sales, Boundary Beach ranks second highest at $1,741,900; the range is $1,364,000 (Cliff Drive) to $1,850,000 (English Bluff). Tsawwassen East ($1,595,000) sits just below and English Bluff ($1,850,000) sits just above.
Townhomes in Boundary Beach have the highest median of the 3 Tsawwassen sub-areas, $1,199,900, ahead of Tsawwassen East at $840,000; the lowest is Tsawwassen North at $739,000.

blocks.text: By build year, duplexes are the newest homes selling in Boundary Beach (median 2026) and houses the oldest (median 2005), a gap of 21 years.
